subject: Civil Engineering
title: Toll Roads and Managed Lanes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Toll Roads and Managed Lanes.

hook.text: Pay to skip the traffic. Managed lanes charge more when congestion is high.

buildup.text: HOV lanes restrict access to carpools. HOT lanes let solo drivers pay to enter.

discovery.text: Dynamic pricing adjusts tolls in real time — $2 at midnight, $15 at rush hour.

twist.text: Congestion pricing keeps the managed lane flowing at 50 mph while free lanes crawl.

climax.text: Stockholm's congestion tax cut city traffic 20% and improved air quality instantly.

punchline.text: Price the road right and congestion manages itself.

quiz.question: How does dynamic pricing on managed lanes reduce congestion?
options: It bans all vehicles during peak hours
Higher tolls during peak times limit demand, keeping traffic flowing
It widens the lanes automatically during rush hour
